_note: The talking helper (js/buddy.js): her dance pet pops up with ONE next step. A message = an opener + the step for the situation + sometimes a true fact. Every {placeholder} is filled from the app's own data (her name, the pet's name, today's plan item, streak, skips, stars, events). Keep lines short, kind, funny; never invent facts.
openers: Hi {name}! I ate a carrot and now I'm READY. 🥕
Knock knock! (It's me. I'm the knock.)
Did somebody say DANCE? No? Well, I did.
I tried a pirouette. I fell over. Your turn! 😅
Fun fact: bunnies can't point their toes. You can!
Ta-daaa! 🎉 Okay, I'll be serious for one second.
I practised my jazz hands. Look! 🙌 …they're paws.
You're back! I was SO bored. I counted my whiskers. Twice.
